chunks: O Allah, bless my nation in its early mornings on its Saturdays and Thursdays.

key_terms.اَللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a direct form of du'a (supplication) to Allah
key_terms.فِي بُكُورِهَا: In its early morning time and early activity

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about blessing in the early morning on Saturdays and Thursdays?
ai.summary: This hadith records a supplication of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم asking Allah to place blessing in the early morning efforts of his Ummah, especially on Saturdays and Thursdays. It highlights the virtue of beginning matters early and points to blessed times connected with productive action and daily life.
